text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out in town with Daiwa
Scarlet, I'm
walking her back to the
dorms, when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey. How do you spend your days off?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-nowhere in particular! It's just... How
should I
put this? For reference!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I need to rest up if I'm going to do well
in my
races, so I'm researching the best
ways to take a
break!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Actually, um, I've been going around
asking
people how they spend their days
off to see what
will work for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's the truth, okay?! It really is for

reference!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So... what do you do in your free time?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So you're one of those types,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I like to read manga when I'm free, so I
kinda get
it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was helpful! I'll see you
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On Daiwa Scarlet's next day off, she
suggests we
watch a movie in my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We both have a great time taking a
break from
training.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So you're one of those types,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I like to go shopping when I'm free, so I
kinda get
it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was helpful! I'll see you
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On Daiwa Scarlet's next day off, she
invites me on
a walk around town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We both have a great time taking a
break from
training.
